performance_acceptance: Open: much shorter loaded text steps and scrolling feedback; idle button pixels unchanged, disk combined feedback slower, and full repairs cost more. The steady CPU-gap target is still exceeded by atomic UPDATE_WIDGETS.
scope: PI3 console, frame/title, exposure and retained-text continuations. PI4, shorter scene-token lifetimes and atomic model continuations remain pending. Production baseline comparison includes the separately regressed guarded interrupt-return fix.

policy.scene_token: Retained through the complete repaint or ordinary row-segment fragment sequence; no source or view pointer survives a worker borrow. Public draws synchronously drain the same traversal.
policy.completion: A held short write finishes its active fragment sequence before reply. Dirty endpoints acknowledge complete segments only; further visible edits wait for prior repair. Cancellation/fault preserve accepted bytes.
policy.mouse_sampling: Unchanged approximately 4 kHz ST capture; no new Task, timer, priority, Yield boundary or repeated geometry validation.

original_cohorts.aes_workload: Unchanged continuous request/reply loop with a 100 ms caller timer after each exchange; completed counts are measured over each gesture cohort, not fixed offered throughput.
